description: Scaffold the apps/house-bot workspace package and implement the honest House Bot (Task 11.1 / REQ-17.1). A Node bot that plays a full game through the real protocol Session (funding is a no-op/injected in tests, commit, relay, reveal) using the same @accident/protocol package as the web Client, choosing guesses with @accident/engine's chooseGuess. Fully driven and tested against the in-memory fakes from @accident/protocol/testing, with no live network. Independent of other in-flight efforts (tasks.md reconciliation, Verifier page) because it only adds apps/house-bot.
steps: Create apps/house-bot/package.json: name "@accident/house-bot", version "0.0.0", private true, type "module", scripts { typecheck: "tsc -p tsconfig.json", test: "vitest --run", test:coverage: "vitest --run --coverage" }. dependencies: "@accident/engine": "workspace:*", "@accident/protocol": "workspace:*", "@accident/solana": "workspace:*". devDependencies: "tsx": "4.23.15" (match the version pinned in packages/solana/package.json) for the optional runnable entry. Mirror the shape of apps/relayer/package.json.
Create apps/house-bot/tsconfig.json extending ../../tsconfig.base.json with compilerOptions { "lib": ["ES2022"], "types": ["node"] } and "include": ["src", "test"]. (Node app, no DOM.)

Create apps/house-bot/vitest.config.ts following apps/relayer/vitest.config.ts: test.include ['test/**/*.test.ts'], coverage provider v8, include ['src/**/*.ts'], reporter ['text','lcov']. Set coverage thresholds to 100 statements/branches/functions/lines to match the relayer bar (adjust only if genuinely unreachable code forces it, and document why in findings).

Create apps/house-bot/src/bot.ts implementing the honest bot driver. Model it on apps/web/src/friend/controller.ts: it builds a Session via Session.create({ room, role, identity, secret, saltHex, hostKey?, transport, chain, storage, clock, options? }), subscribes with session.subscribe(view => ...), and when view.canGuess is true chooses and submits a guess. Guess selection MUST reuse the engine: build a Turn[] from view.guesses and view.answers (pairing guess i with answer i for i < answers.length), call candidatesFromHistory(history) to get the consistent codes, then chooseGuess(level, candidates, rng) to pick the move, and session.submitGuess(code). Default level 'medium', default rng secureRng(); allow both to be injected for deterministic tests (e.g. mulberry32). Expose a class (e.g. HouseBot) with: a constructor taking { room, role, identity, secret, saltHex, hostKey?, level?, rng?, transport, chain, storage, clock, options? }; async start(); view(); transcript(); subscribe(); and async close(). Do not re-implement any protocol logic: funding/commit/gate/auto-answer/reveal all come from Session.

Add apps/house-bot/src/secret.ts (or fold into bot.ts) a small helper that generates the bot's own secret and salt using the engine/protocol: randomCode(rng) for the secret and generateSaltHex() for the salt, so a bot can be constructed without the caller supplying them. Keep it injectable for tests.
Create apps/house-bot/src/index.ts re-exporting the public bot API (HouseBot and its options/types).

Create apps/house-bot/src/live.ts: an OPTIONAL thin wrapper that constructs a HouseBot wired to the real SolanaChain (from @accident/solana) and a real transport, reading config (RPC url, room) from process.env. This file is for live/manual use only; it MUST NOT be imported by any test and MUST NOT perform network I/O at import time. Exclude it from coverage include if needed (e.g. add 'src/live.ts' to coverage.exclude) so the 100% bar applies only to the tested bot core. Document this exclusion in findings.

Create apps/house-bot/test/bot.test.ts: drive TWO HouseBots (seat 0 host, seat 1 guest) against ONE shared MemoryHub (each gets hub.transport(name)), a shared MemoryChain, each with its own MemoryStorage, and a shared ManualClock, all from @accident/protocol/testing. STUDY packages/protocol/test/harness.ts FIRST: its `autoplay(player, level, seed)` is a proven honest-bot driver (subscribe, build history from view.guesses/view.answers filtered to own seat, candidatesFromHistory -> chooseGuess with mulberry32), and `until(world, done, limitMs, stepMs)` advances the ManualClock in small steps while awaiting settle until done; `isDone` checks phase in ['final','abandoned']. The HouseBot's internal guess loop should match that autoplay logic. NOTE: the harness uses useDeterministicCrypto() (a synchronous SHA-256 stub) so games run deterministically under the fake clock; the bot test must do the same (replicate that beforeEach/afterEach, or import an equivalent) or the commit/reveal hashing will race the ManualClock. Give each bot a deterministic secret and a seeded mulberry32 rng; advance time with the `until` pattern (and confirm chain commits as the session tests do) until both are done. Assert: both reach phase 'final'; the verdict.kind is 'final' with NO 'wrong-answer' faults (honest play); and the game actually progressed (view.guesses.length > 0). This proves REQ-17.1 end-to-end through the real protocol.
acceptance_criteria: apps/house-bot is a recognised pnpm workspace member (appears in `pnpm -r` output) after `pnpm install`.
`pnpm --filter @accident/house-bot test` passes, including a test where two honest HouseBots play a complete game to a 'final' verdict with no faults.

The honest bot contains no duplicated protocol logic: commit, play gate, auto-answer and reveal are performed by the protocol Session, and guesses come from engine chooseGuess over candidatesFromHistory.
No test performs live network I/O; all behaviour is exercised via @accident/protocol/testing fakes.
Repo-root `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm format:check`, and `pnpm test` all pass.
verification: Run `pnpm install` at repo root to link the new workspace package.
Run `pnpm --filter @accident/house-bot test` and confirm the two-bot honest game test passes.
Run `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm format:check`, and `pnpm test` at repo root and confirm all pass.
findings:
Implemented apps/house-bot (@accident/house-bot) with src/bot.ts (HouseBot + exported pure chooseHonestGuess), src/secret.ts (makeChoice), src/index.ts barrel, src/live.ts (optional Solana/transport wiring, never imported by tests, no import-time I/O), and test/bot.test.ts. The bot drives the real @accident/protocol Session; commit/gate/auto-answer/reveal/finalise all come from Session, and guesses come solely from engine chooseGuess over candidatesFromHistory, mirroring the proven harness autoplay logic. Test replicates useDeterministicCrypto's synchronous SHA-256 stub (beforeEach/afterEach) and the until(clock, done) stepping pattern so games run deterministically under ManualClock. MemoryChain default holdBack is false (commits/reveals visible immediately), so confirmAll() is not needed for the happy path (same as packages/protocol session.happy.test.ts). Two honest bots reach phase 'final' with an identical verdict, zero faults (no wrong-answer), verifiedSecrets ['1964','4271'], guesses.length>0.

DEPENDENCY: added @solana/web3.js@1.99.0 as a direct dependency (version matched to apps/relayer and packages/solana) because src/live.ts imports Connection from it; tsc requires the direct dep. Re-ran pnpm install (lockfile updated: only the apps/house-bot importer block added).

COVERAGE EXCLUSIONS (vitest.config.ts coverage.exclude): 'src/index.ts' (pure re-export barrel, excluded repo-wide per packages/engine and packages/protocol vitest configs) and 'src/live.ts' (manual/live wiring touching @solana/web3.js and a real transport, never exercised in tests). The tested core (bot.ts, secret.ts) is at 100% statements/branches/functions/lines. To reach 100% on bot.ts, the error-capture path in onView's submitGuess().catch is covered by closing the bot the instant it can guess so the queued guess rejects against a closed session; the chooseHonestGuess OPENING_GUESS fallback is covered via a view with contradictory feedback on the bot's own turns.

PRE-EXISTING, UNRELATED ISSUES in the in-flight 'Verifier page' work left uncommitted in the tree (apps/web, not touched by this feature): apps/web/playwright.config.ts has a prettier violation, and apps/web/test/verifier-page.test.tsx can intermittently fail with a tweetnacl 'use Uint8Array' error depending on test-file isolation/ordering (reproduced with apps/house-bot fully removed and the lockfile reverted to baseline, so it is not caused by this change). The full `pnpm test` passed green in the final run (197 web tests + 8 house-bot tests). Only apps/house-bot, pnpm-lock.yaml, and .agents/tasks/task-house-bot were committed; the web app's uncommitted changes were left untouched.
